entries.reason: owed: coordination/api-queue.md names this row, under 'UIKit 26.x - two rows owed because the surface predates them'. A 26.4 name cannot appear in the SDK 26.2 SURFACE by construction - the surface predates it - so there is no declaration in the tree to read the signature from, and carrying the property on a remembered signature would be a guess with a symbol on it. What closes it is a newer surface that declares the row, not a different implementation
entries.effect: NOT implemented while the row is owed: the accessor is not declared, so respondsToSelector: answers NO and an unchecked call raises - the same position an `absent` row is in, and the difference is why this one is owed rather than absent: the RELEASE carries the name and the PORT could carry it
